plan_review.notes: Adversarial rubber-duck review considered 3 alternative designs before endorsing the chosen one. 2 Blocking concerns (fragile skip/summary same-tick cancellation timing; reduced-motion stacked N reveal cues) fixed architecturally (suppressPhaseChangeHook + reveal coalescing). 2 Non-Blocking concerns (isAvailable() reports support not playability; re-entrant open() overwrites state) accepted as safe-by-construction trade-offs, documented in ADR 0071.

rounds.notes: 2 valid findings fixed: gain-floor-at-now for delayed cues; skip cue not scaled by intensity. Round marked non-clean per harness policy — a round that produced fixes cannot validate the post-fix diff.

Follow-up round after round-1 fixes. Two new valid findings raised by automated review: (1) cue label mismatch — implementation emits reward:reveal/reward:escalation but PR contract specifies reward:item-revealed/reward:rarity-escalation; (2) multi-item batch coalescing applied only in reduced-motion mode but normal-mode large-delta frames can also advance revealedCount by >1. Both fixed (label rename + condition change to batchSize>1 regardless of reducedMotion).
Post-fix validation after round-2 fixes landed. No new concerns across all categories: correctness, contracts, policy compliance, determinism, lifecycle, wiring, performance.
